description: This file contains automated tests for the Keystone project CLI commands, including build and start, using the Jest framework. It tests behaviors such as error handling when build hasn't been run, successful TypeScript builds, and environment variable settings during production.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for CLI behaviors such as error states and successful runs.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Provides assertion methods to validate test outcomes.

methods.name: ms
methods.description: Converts human-readable time durations into milliseconds for setting timeouts.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file asynchronously.

methods.name: execa
methods.description: Executes external commands and retrieves their output.

methods.name: testdir
methods.description: Sets up a temporary test directory with provided configuration.

methods.name: cliMock
methods.description: Mocks or invokes the CLI commands for testing purposes.
